BiblicalUsage: Dikaios as an adverb means justly, righteously, acting the way a righteous person acts. Paul calls the Corinthians to wake up and live righteously, and reminds the Thessalonians how justly he behaved among them. Even the thief on the cross admitted he and his fellow criminal were suffering justly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe living justly is not a pose but the natural shape of a life that has been made right with God. Christ suffered without threatening, leaving His cause to the righteous Judge, and I follow Him by doing the same.
